arxiv-2104-05093.title: Load Balancing with Dynamic Set of Balls and Bins
arxiv-2104-05093.creator: Anders Aamand, Jakob Bæk Tejs Knudsen, Mikkel Thorup
arxiv-2104-05093.description: Abstract In dynamic load balancing, we wish to distribute balls into bins in an environment where both balls and bins can be added and removed. We want to minimize the maximum load of any bin but we also want to minimize the number of balls and bins that are affected when adding or removing a ball or a bin.

arxiv-2107-09678.title: Identifying AGN host galaxies by Machine Learning with HSC+WISE
arxiv-2107-09678.creator: Yu-Yen Chang, Bau-Ching Hsieh, Wei-Hao Wang, Yen-Ting Lin, Chen-Fatt Lim, Yoshiki Toba, Yuxing Zhong, Siou-Yu Chang
arxiv-2107-09678.description: Abstract We use machine learning techniques to investigate their performance in classifying active galactic nuclei (AGNs), including X-ray selected AGNs (XAGNs), infrared selected AGNs (IRAGNs), and radio selected AGNs (RAGNs). Using known physical parameters in the Cosmic Evolution Survey (COSMOS) field, we are able to well-established training samples in the region of Hyper Suprime-Cam (HSC) survey.

arxiv-2303-11798.title: A large-momentum-transfer matter-wave interferometer to measure the effect of gravity on positronium Journal: Class. Quantum Grav.
arxiv-2303-11798.creator: G Vinelli, F Castelli, R Ferragut, M Romé, M Sacerdoti, L Salvi, V Toso, M Giammarchi, G Rosi, G M Tino
arxiv-2303-11798.description: Abstract This paper reports the study of a new interferometric configuration to measure the effect of gravity on positronium. A Mach-Zehnder matter-wave interferometer has been designed to operate with single-photon transitions and to transfer high momentum to a 200 eV positronium beam.

arxiv-2308-03475.title: COPA : Efficient Vision-Language Pre-training Through Collaborative Object- and Patch-Text Alignment Conference: Proceedings of the 31st ACM International Conference on Multimedia; October 29-November 3, 2023; Ottawa, ON, Canada Proceedings of the 31st ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM
arxiv-2308-03475.creator: Chaoya Jiang, Haiyang Xu, Wei Ye, Qinghao Ye, Chenliang Li, Ming Yan, Bin Bi, Shikun Zhang, Ji Zhang, Fei Huang
arxiv-2308-03475.description: Abstract . Vision-Language Pre-training (VLP) methods based on object detection enjoy the rich knowledge of fine-grained object-text alignment but at the cost of computationally expensive inference. Recent Visual-Transformer (ViT)-based approaches circumvent this issue while struggling with long visual sequences without detailed cross-modal alignment information.

arxiv-2310-20556.title: Coordinate-space calculation of QED corrections to the hadronic vacuum polarization contribution to ( g − 2 ) μ (g-2)_{\mu}
arxiv-2310-20556.description: Abstract As several lattice collaborations agree on the result for the window quantity of the hadronic vacuum polarization (HVP) contribution to ( g − 2 ) μ (g-2)_{\mu} , whilst being in tension with the calculation using the dispersive approach, further effort is needed in order to pin down the cause for this difference.

arxiv-2412-08915.title: Improving Multiresource Job Scheduling with Markovian Service Rate Policies
arxiv-2412-08915.creator: Zhongrui Chen, Isaac Grosof, Benjamin Berg
arxiv-2412-08915.description: Abstract . Modern cloud computing workloads are composed of multiresource jobs that require a variety of computational resources in order to run, such as CPU cores, memory, disk space, or hardware accelerators. A single cloud server can typically run many multiresource jobs in parallel, but only if the server has sufficient resources to satisfy the demands of every job.

arxiv-2507-08044.title: ConsNoTrainLoRA: Data-driven Weight Initialization of Low-rank Adapters using Constraints Thanks: Qualcomm AI Research is an initiative of Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
arxiv-2507-08044.creator: Debasmit Das, Hyoungwoo Park, Munawar Hayat, Seokeon Choi, Sungrack Yun, Fatih Porikli
arxiv-2507-08044.description: Abstract Foundation models are pre-trained on large-scale datasets and subsequently fine-tuned on small-scale datasets using parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) techniques like low-rank adapters (LoRA). In most previous works, LoRA weight matrices are randomly initialized with a fixed rank across all attachment points.

arxiv-2508-15522.title: GridFF: Efficient Simulation of Organic Molecules on Rigid Substrates
arxiv-2508-15522.creator: Indranil Mal, Milan Kočí, Paolo Nicolini, Prokop Hapala
arxiv-2508-15522.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Indranil Mal, Milan Kočí, Paolo Nicolini, Prokop Hapala. We present GridFF, an efficient method for simulating molecules on rigid substrates, derived from techniques used in protein - ligand docking in biochemistry. By projecting molecule - substrate interactions onto precomputed spatial grids with tricubic B-spline interpolation, GridFF reduces the computational cost by orders of magnitude compared to traditional pairwise atomistic models, without compromising the accuracy of forces or trajectories.

arxiv-2510-20073.title: An inverse and a stability result for Ruzsa’s inequality on triple sumsets
arxiv-2510-20073.creator: Swaroop Hegde
arxiv-2510-20073.description: Abstract . Ruzsa’s inequality states that | A + A + A | ≤ | A + A | 3 / 2 |A+A+A|\leq|A+A|^{3/2} for any finite set A A in a commutative group. Ruzsa has constructed examples showing that this inequality is sharp asymptotically, up to a constant factor.

arxiv-2510-24990.title: The Economics of AI Training Data: A Research Agenda
arxiv-2510-24990.creator: Hamidah Oderinwale, Anna Kazlauskas
arxiv-2510-24990.description: Abstract Despite data’s central role in AI production, it remains the least understood input. As AI labs exhaust public data and turn to proprietary sources with deals reaching hundreds of millions of dollars, research across computer science, economics, law, and policy has fragmented. We establish data economics as a coherent field through three contributions.

arxiv-2512-00697.title: Polynomial bounds for Birch’s theorem Thanks: AL was supported by NSF grant DMS-2402041 Thanks: AS was supported by NSF grant DMS-2301871 Thanks: TZ was supported by ISF grant 697/24 and ERC grant DyAddAlg (101199203)
arxiv-2512-00697.creator: Amichai Lampert, Andrew Snowden, Tamar Ziegler
arxiv-2512-00697.description: Abstract . Let K K be a number field and f 1 , … , f s ∈ K ⁡ [ x 1 , … , x n ] f_{1},\ldots,f_{s}\in K[x_{1},\ldots,x_{n}] forms of odd degrees. In 1957, Birch proved that if n n is sufficiently large then the forms always have a nontrivial zero in K n K^{n} .

arxiv-2601-11753.title: Entanglement Distribution over a Polarization-Stabilized Aerial Fiber Journal: opticajournal Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2601-11753.creator: Yicheng Shi, 1,* Jing Su, 1,2, Anouar Rahmouni 1,2, Pranish Shrestha 1,3, Mheni Merzouki 1, Gabriel Bello Portmann 4, Anne Lazenby 4, Mael Flament 4, Mehdi Namazi 4, Abdella Battou 1, Oliver Slattery 1 and Thomas Gerrits 1
arxiv-2601-11753.description: Abstract Distributing quantum entanglement over telecommunication fiber is a fundamental task in metropolitan-scale quantum networks, enabling advanced applications such as quantum-secured communication, quantum sensing and distributed quantum computing. Although polarization entanglement is relatively easy to generate and manipulate, its distribution across deployed fibers is challenging because of the time-varying polarization transformations imposed by the fiber, which must be actively stabilized.

arxiv-2602-11152.title: Utilitarian Distortion Under Probabilistic Voting
arxiv-2602-11152.creator: Hamidreza Alipour, Mohak Goyal
arxiv-2602-11152.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Hamidreza Alipour, Mohak Goyal. The utilitarian distortion framework evaluates voting rules by their worst-case efficiency loss when voters have cardinal utilities but express only ordinal rankings. Under the classical model, a longstanding tension exists: Plurality, which discards most of the ranking information and suffers from the spoiler effect, achieves optimal Θ ⁡ ( m 2 ) \Theta(m^{2}) distortion among deterministic rules, while normatively superior rules like Copeland and Borda have unbounded distortion.

arxiv-2602-20013.title: Quantum Correlation and Coherence in a Mononuclear Nickel-Based Molecular Magnet
arxiv-2602-20013.creator: S. Bhuvaneswari, R. Muthuganesan, R. Radha
arxiv-2602-20013.description: Abstract We investigate the behaviors of thermal entanglement, quantum correlation beyond entanglement namely, measurement-induced nonlocality (MIN) and coherence in a nickel radical molecular magnet ( Et 3 ​ NH ) ​ [ Ni(hfac) 2 ​ L ] (\text{Et}_{3}\text{NH})[\text{Ni(hfac)}_{2}L] , whose spin-spin interactions are well described by the Heisenberg model.

pmc-10547710.title: Minimal amount of exercise prevents incident dementia in cognitively normal older adults with osteoarthritis: a retrospective longitudinal follow-up study
pmc-10547710.creator: Yu-Hsuan Chung, Cheng-Yu Wei, Ray-Chang Tzeng, Pai-Yi Chiu
pmc-10547710.description: Robust evidence suggests that regular exercise, including walking more than 6000 steps, is effective for preventing dementia; however, such activity is less feasible in older people with osteoarthritis (OA) or other motor disabilities. Therefore, we aimed to test whether the minimal amount of exercise (MAE) could help prevent dementia in older adults with OA.

pmc-10573498.title: Management and 1-Year Outcome in Elderly Patients with Hip Fracture Surgery Receiving Anticoagulation (Warfarin or DOAc) or P2Y12 Antiplatelet Agents
pmc-10573498.creator: Carlo Rostagno, Gaia Rubbieri, Mattia Zeppa, Alessandro Cartei, Alice Ceccofiglio, Giulio Maria Mannarino, Gualtiero Palareti, Elvira Grandone, Paul Macey, Moshe Salai
pmc-10573498.description: (1) Background: Little prospective data exist regarding the perioperative management and long-term prognosis of elderly patients receiving treatment with antithrombotic drugs and undergoing urgent surgery for a hip fracture. (2) Methods: The study included patients who required hip surgery and were receiving warfarin, DOAc or P2Y12 antiplatelet agents at the moment of trauma.

pmc-10612313.title: Albumin-bound paclitaxel augment temozolomide treatment sensitivity of glioblastoma cells by disrupting DNA damage repair and promoting ferroptosis
pmc-10612313.creator: Shanqiang Qu, Songtao Qi, Huayang Zhang, Zhiyong Li, Kaicheng Wang, Taichen Zhu, Rongxu Ye, Wanghao Zhang, Guanglong Huang, Guo-zhong Yi
pmc-10612313.description: BackgroundTemozolomide (TMZ) treatment efficacy in glioblastoma (GBM) patients has been limited by resistance in the clinic. Currently, there are no clinically proven therapeutic options available to restore TMZ treatment sensitivity. Here, we investigated the potential of albumin-bound paclitaxel (ABX), a novel microtubule targeting agent, in sensitizing GBM cells to TMZ and elucidated its underlying molecular mechanism.

pmc-10619279.title: Middle aged and older adult’s perspectives of their own home environment: a review of qualitative studies and meta-synthesis
pmc-10619279.creator: Roslyn Aclan, Stacey George, Heather Block, Rachel Lane, Kate Laver
pmc-10619279.description: BackgroundMost people prefer to remain in their homes and communities as long as possible. Staying at home is widely beneficial as ageing within the home promotes independence and costs less than residential aged care. Understanding meanings and drivers of remaining at home is an area of importance.

pmc-10629504.title: Deep Learning Analysis of COVID-19 Vaccine Hesitancy and Confidence Expressed on Twitter in 6 High-Income Countries: Longitudinal Observational Study
pmc-10629504.creator: Xinyu Zhou, Suhang Song, Ying Zhang, Zhiyuan Hou, Taiane de Azevedo Cardoso, Andrzej Jarynowski, Senlin Lin
pmc-10629504.description: BackgroundAn ongoing monitoring of national and subnational trajectory of COVID-19 vaccine hesitancy could offer support in designing tailored policies on improving vaccine uptake.ObjectiveWe aim to track the temporal and spatial distribution of COVID-19 vaccine hesitancy and confidence expressed on Twitter during the entire pandemic period in major English-speaking countries.

pmc-11531633.title: Perioperative Outcomes of Intramedullary Nail vs Hemiarthroplasty vs Total Hip Arthroplasty for Intertrochanteric Fracture: An Analysis of 31,519 Cases
pmc-11531633.creator: Natalia Czerwonka, Sohil S Desai, Puneet Gupta, Roshan P Shah, Jeffrey A Geller, H John Cooper, Alexander L Neuwirth
pmc-11531633.description: BackgroundThe purpose of this study is to compare 30-day perioperative outcomes following treatment of intertrochanteric (IT) fractures with intramedullary nail (IMN), total hip arthroplasty (THA), or hemiarthroplasty (HA).MethodsUsing the National Surgical Quality Improvement Program database, we conducted a retrospective cohort study of patients who had sustained an IT fracture treated with primary IMN, THA, or HA between 2017 and 2020.

pmc-11688742.title: IDENTIFICATION OF PATIENT PORTAL MESSAGES SENT FROM NON–PROXY ACCOUNT CARE PARTNERS AND THEIR PORTAL USE PATTERNS
pmc-11688742.creator: Jennifer Portz, Daniel Martin, Kelly Gleason, Karla Washington, Andrea Daddato, Dave Powers, Jason Lyons, Elizabeth Bayliss
pmc-11688742.description: Automating care partner identification via the electronic health record (EHR) can streamline the delivery of evidence-based caregiving interventions through patient portals and is vital for supporting care partners of people living with dementia (PLWD). This retrospective cohort study focused on identifying patient portal messages from non-proxy care partners and exploring associated portal usage.

pmc-12407445.title: The antiadipogenic effect of the pentacyclic triterpenoid isoarborinol is mediated by LKB1-AMPK activation
pmc-12407445.creator: Yesenia Arcos-Reyes, Gildardo Rivera, Laurence A. Marchat, Juan Salas-Benito, Gilberto Mandujano-Lázaro, Moisés Monzón-Gualito, Esther Ramírez-Moreno, Sayed Haidar Abbas Raza, Sayed Haidar Abbas Raza, Sayed Haidar Abbas Raza, Sayed Haidar Abbas Raza
pmc-12407445.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Obesity and overweight are two highly prevalent conditions worldwide, which can lead to death or produce chronic and degenerative diseases. The search for alternative therapies to control these morbidities can involve the study of metabolites obtained from plants. Particularly, pentacyclic triterpenes produce an antiadipogenic effect by affecting the expression of master regulators of adipogenesis and their signaling pathways, including LKB1-AMPK pathway. In this work, we evaluated the effect of the pentacyclic triterpene isoarborinol on adipogenesis in 3T3-L1 cells.

pmc-12433226.title: Demographic Characteristics, Contributing Risk Factors, and Prognosis of Acanthamoeba Keratitis in Eastern China: An in vivo Confocal Microscopy-Based Fifteen-Year Study
pmc-12433226.creator: Chuwei Lu, Jiajia Wang, Jiaxu Hong, Jianjiang Xu, Xujiao Zhou, Lijia Tian, Qihua Le
pmc-12433226.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). PurposeTo investigate the demographic characteristics, contributing risk factors, and prognostic outcomes of Acanthamoeba keratitis (AK) in Eastern China in the recent 15 years using in vivo confocal microscopy (IVCM).Patients and MethodsThis single-center, retrospective study included 145 patients (147 eyes) diagnosed with AK based on IVCM findings at the Eye & ENT Hospital of Fudan University from April 2009 to September 2024.

pmc-12538725.title: Persistent pain and brain fog after COVID-19 infection in European adults aged 50 and over: a population-based longitudinal study
pmc-12538725.creator: Xiaona He, Wei Gao
pmc-12538725.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundPsychological distress has been identified as a risk factor for long COVID in individuals infected with COVID-19. Little is known about the differences in long COVID symptom profiles between older adults with pre-existing depression and those without.MethodsA population-based longitudinal prospective study was performed using the Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe (SHARE) with participants aged 50 years and older. Depression was assessed by the EURO-D scale at the baseline. Long COVID symptoms were self-reported by participants during the 12-month follow-up.

pmc-12607876.title: Host cysteine proteases promote the severity of catheter-associated urinary tract infection and kidney fibrosis
pmc-12607876.creator: Wei Xu, Jian Chen, Lisa K. McLellan, Ana L. Flores-Mireles, David A. Hunstad, Michael G. Caparon
pmc-12607876.description: The bacterium Enterococcus faecalis is a leading cause of catheter-associated urinary tract infection (CAUTI), whose treatment is increasingly challenged by antibiotic resistance. In examining alternative therapies, we previously found that the cysteine protease inhibitor E64 dramatically reduced bladder inflammation and bacterial dissemination in a murine model of E. faecalis CAUTI.

pmc-12658300.title: Sustainable diets: where from and where to?
pmc-12658300.creator: Lesley Macheka, Rebecca Kanter, Mark Lawrence, Sandro Dernini, Farah Naja, Stineke Oenema
pmc-12658300.description: The multilevel dimensions of sustainable diets associating food systems, public health, environmental sustainability, and culture are presented in this paper. It begins by defining sustainable diets as those that are healthful, have low environmental impacts, are affordable, and culturally acceptable.

pmc-12845506.title: Emulsome-Based Nanocarrier System for Controlled 4-Phenylbutyric Acid Delivery and Mechanistic Mitigation of Arsenical-Induced Skin Injury via Foam Application
pmc-12845506.creator: Nethra Viswaroopan, Meheli Ghosh, Sharvari M. Kshirsagar, Jasim Khan, Jennifer Toral-Orduno, Ritesh K. Srivastava, Mohammad Athar, Ajay K. Banga
pmc-12845506.description: Background: Lewisite, a potent chemical warfare agent, induces rapid and progressive cutaneous damage, necessitating treatment strategies that offer both immediate decontamination and prolonged therapeutic action. This study aimed to develop and evaluate a composite topical formulation comprising 4-phenylbutyric acid (4-PBA)-loaded emulsomes embedded within a foam vehicle to address both aspects of vesicant-induced skin injury intervention.

pmc-13155718.title: Facial Melanosis: A Comprehensive Review of Uncommon and Common Presentations with Personal Experience
pmc-13155718.creator: Rashmi Sarkar, Damini Verma
pmc-13155718.description: Facial melanoses (FMs) encompass a diverse group of disorders characterised by altered facial pigmentation, particularly prevalent in individuals with darker skin types, such as the Indian population. While common causes like melasma, post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation, and lichen planus pigmentosus are well documented in the literature, this review emphasises the lesser-known and uncommon causes of FM.

pmc-13415047.title: Beyond R-Genes: Dissecting Metabolic and Nutrient-Driven Wheat Rust Resistance Through Induced Mutagenesis
pmc-13415047.creator: Saule Kenzhebayeva, Alfia Abekova, Nargul Omirbekova, Sabina Shoinbekova, Saule Atabayeva, Gulina Doktyrbay, Aigul Amirova, Albrecht Serfling
pmc-13415047.description: The increasing threat posed by wheat rust diseases caused by Puccinia spp. necessitates the development of resistance strategies that extend beyond conventional race-specific mechanisms. Although recent reviews (2023–2025) have emphasized gene discovery and genomic approaches, comparatively less attention has been given to the potential roles of metabolic regulation and micronutrient homeostasis in host–pathogen interactions.
